reference: Maximally structured causal metadata for the Sachs cellular signaling network
context: Single-cell flow cytometry measurements of intracellular signaling proteins and phospholipids. Metadata is enriched for Bayesian causal discovery, mechanistic graph reconstruction, Markov blanket estimation, and probabilistic pathway inference.

variables.name: PKC
variables.label: Protein Kinase C activity
variables.description: Integrated phosphorylation readout capturing activity across multiple PKC isoforms.
variables.causal_mechanism: Activated downstream of PLCγ-mediated DAG and calcium signaling. PKC propagates intracellular signaling and modulates MAPK pathway activity.

cpt_shape_hints.High: Most probable when Plcg=High and PIP2=Moderate/High
cpt_shape_hints.Low: Likely when PLCγ activity is absent or PIP2 substrate is depleted

variables.quantitative_notes: PKC activation frequently exhibits nonlinear threshold effects due to second messenger amplification.

variables.name: PKA
variables.label: Protein Kinase A substrate activity
variables.description: Aggregate motif-based phosphorylation signal reflecting cyclic AMP dependent kinase activity.
variables.causal_mechanism: Acts through cAMP-mediated phosphorylation cascades largely parallel to MAPK signaling.

cpt_shape_hints.Low: Observed under minimal cyclic AMP activation

variables.quantitative_notes: PKA often behaves as a partially independent signaling axis in perturbation experiments.

variables.name: Raf
variables.label: Raf phosphorylation
variables.description: Upstream MAPK regulator controlling MEK phosphorylation dynamics.
variables.causal_mechanism: Receives upstream signaling from receptor and PKC-related pathways and activates MEK.

cpt_shape_hints.Inactive: Likely when upstream signaling is weak

variables.quantitative_notes: Raf activation exhibits switch-like behavior in MAPK cascade propagation.

variables.name: Mek
variables.label: MEK phosphorylation
variables.description: Central kinase mediating Raf-to-ERK information transfer.
variables.causal_mechanism: Activated directly by Raf and propagates downstream MAPK signaling toward ERK.

cpt_shape_hints.Inactive: Occurs when Raf signaling is absent

variables.quantitative_notes: MEK activation generally follows monotonic dependence on Raf activity.

variables.name: Erk
variables.label: ERK phosphorylation
variables.description: Terminal MAPK signaling output associated with proliferation and transcriptional activation.
variables.causal_mechanism: Activated downstream of MEK and integrates proliferative signaling responses.
variables.quantitative_notes: ERK commonly displays sustained activation under strong pathway stimulation.

variables.name: Akt
variables.label: Akt phosphorylation
variables.description: Downstream PI3K/Akt pathway kinase involved in metabolism and survival signaling.
variables.causal_mechanism: Activated through membrane recruitment driven by PIP3 accumulation.

cpt_shape_hints.Inactive: Likely when PIP3 levels are depleted

variables.quantitative_notes: Akt signaling often exhibits strong positive dependence on PI3K lipid signaling.

variables.name: Jnk
variables.label: JNK phosphorylation
variables.description: Stress-activated MAPK pathway component responding to perturbation.
variables.causal_mechanism: Activated by environmental stress and inflammatory signaling.

cpt_shape_hints.Active: More likely during stress perturbation conditions

variables.quantitative_notes: JNK and P38 frequently co-activate during stress conditions.

variables.name: P38
variables.label: p38 phosphorylation
variables.description: MAPK stress-response signaling component associated with inflammatory pathways.
variables.causal_mechanism: Activated under stress and inflammatory signaling conditions.
variables.quantitative_notes: P38 exhibits strong statistical association with JNK signaling activity.

variables.name: Plcg
variables.label: PLCγ phosphorylation
variables.description: Phospholipase signaling regulator controlling phosphoinositide hydrolysis.
variables.causal_mechanism: Consumes PIP2 to generate second messengers driving PKC activation.

cpt_shape_hints.Active: Most probable when sufficient PIP2 substrate exists
cpt_shape_hints.Inactive: Likely when phosphoinositide signaling is absent

variables.quantitative_notes: PLCγ often acts as a branching point for calcium and PKC signaling.

variables.name: PIP3
variables.label: Phosphatidylinositol (3,4,5)-trisphosphate
variables.description: Membrane phospholipid generated by PI3K activity.
variables.causal_mechanism: Acts as a membrane docking signal for Akt recruitment and activation.

cpt_shape_hints.High: Occurs during active PI3K signaling and abundant PIP2 substrate

variables.quantitative_notes: PIP3 is typically sparse but highly informative for Akt pathway activation.

variables.name: PIP2
variables.label: Phosphatidylinositol (4,5)-bisphosphate
variables.description: Membrane phospholipid precursor consumed by PLCγ and PI3K signaling pathways.
variables.causal_mechanism: Serves as upstream substrate for both PIP3 generation and PLCγ-mediated second messenger signaling.

cpt_shape_hints.High: Observed when phospholipid turnover is limited
cpt_shape_hints.Low: Occurs under strong consumption by PI3K and PLCγ pathways

variables.quantitative_notes: PIP2 acts as a shared upstream substrate node linking multiple signaling branches.
